summary: Iteration 7 — verified P0 (real Razorpay), P1 (balance payment, disputes, live chat), and P2 (shipping providers, route-module refactor regression) end-to-end. Backend pytest suite is now 92/92 passing serially (added 10 new tests covering /api/shipping/providers, /api/chat/threads (support+order), /api/orders/{id}/dispute + /api/admin/disputes + resolve-dispute (refund and reject paths, invalid action, RBAC), /api/custom-requests/{id}/pay-balance blocking completion until paid). Frontend: real Razorpay checkout.js modal opens on Cart 'PAY ₹253' (window.Razorpay defined, razorpay iframe rendered, 'Sketch Pay Demo' modal is INACTIVE); /chat page loads with 4 conversations, message sent by customer visible to support (5s polling verified messages count updated); /orders/:id shows order-dispute-btn and order-chat-btn — dispute modal (dispute-reason + dispute-submit) posts and page updates to DISPUTED status with a 'Dispute raised' toast; admin /admin renders all 14 tabs including admin-tab-disputes (empty state now after resolve tests ran); live-chat-btn present on /support. All regression pages (/, /reels, /marketplace, /orders, /profile, /studio, /notifications, /settings, /verification, /cart) load without 404/500.

ui_bugs.issue: Order cards are NOT clickable — there is no anchor or navigation from the /orders list into /orders/:id. Users can only reach order detail (where dispute/chat buttons live) via direct URL. Adds a UX gap for buyers wanting to raise disputes / chat with sellers.

action_items: Make order cards on /orders navigable — wrap each card in a Link to /orders/:id (or add a 'View details' button with data-testid='order-view-<id>') so buyers can reach the dispute/chat surface without typing the URL.
(Optional) Add stub test data — /orders/:id dispute+chat buttons only work for the buyer of that order; the current UI shows both buttons unconditionally on disputable statuses which is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py refactor is clean (81 lines wiring only) — 25 route modules under /app/backend/routes/*.py, deps.py holds shared helpers. No route paths changed — all /api/* endpoints from prior iterations still respond.
disputes.py properly guards Razorpay refund path (only calls rzp.payment.refund when payment_id starts with pay_ and isn't pay_mock_) — good defensive check for mixed environments.
chat.py: chat_access check on GET/POST protects non-participants. Support broadcast is limited to STAFF_ROLES via the $or query — correct.
custom_requests.py pay-balance: correctly requires cr.status in {in_progress, delivered} and blocks completion until balance_paid=True — matches P1 spec (30% advance + 70% balance).
shipping.py: providers endpoint returns live:false when SHIPROCKET creds absent — correct env-gating.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added TestShippingProviders, TestChat, TestDisputes, TestOrderChat, TestCustomBalancePayment — 10 new tests, 92 total pass serial -n 0)

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all iteration-7 flows verified; one UX gap on /orders list navigation)

test_credentials: Verified via /app/memory/test_credentials.md — customer@sketch.app, admin@sketch.app, support@sketch.app, aarav@sketch.app all worked as expected.
seed_data_creation: TestDisputes creates transient TEST_ orders and disputes them (some resolved to refunded, some to their prev_status). TestCustomBalancePayment creates a full advance→balance→completed custom_request. These are TEST_ prefixed and safely ignorable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest MUST run with -n 0 (serial). Backend now 92 tests. Razorpay is LIVE-test-mode — /payments/create returns gateway=razorpay and key_id; verify signs with HMAC. Chat endpoints: POST /api/chat/threads {kind:'support'} idempotent per user; kind='order' idempotent per order_id. Disputes admin queue at GET /api/admin/disputes (open only). Custom balance: pay-balance is 70% and complete is blocked until balance_paid. UI testids: order-dispute-btn, dispute-modal (implicit via reason/submit), dispute-reason, dispute-submit, order-chat-btn, live-chat-btn, chat-page, chat-input, chat-send, chat-new-support, admin-tab-disputes. The /orders list page has no navigation into /orders/:id — users must know the URL; suggest wrapping cards in Link.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions. New features work as specified. One UX gap noted on /orders list navigation into /orders/:id.
